title: Pretransplant immune dysregulation and survival after HSCT in pediatric inborn errors of immunity.
snippet: Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) is curative for many inborn errors of immunity (IEIs), but the prognostic role of pretransplant immune dysregulation in pediatric patients remains unclear.
